bitstream.issue: uint8_t position wraps at 255, causing re-reads from start
bitstream.fix: Position trait: usize (safe, no wrap) vs u8 (ABI, wrapping_add)
bitstream.hint: Emit Reader<P: Position>. Safe path stops at end; ABI wraps.

dstr.issue: Empty find string causes infinite loop; capacity overflow possible
dstr.fix: Safe replace: empty needle is no-op; grow carefully or use Vec
dstr.hint: Use Dstr with checked operations. Differential vs C ABI.

utf8.fix: Walk back to valid UTF-8 boundary
utf8.hint: Use truncate_utf8 / truncate_filename. Never split codepoints.

path_extension.issue: NULL or empty path may dereference
path_extension.fix: Return None for null/empty; find last . after last separator

null_safety.issue: Many C helpers crash or UB on NULL
null_safety.fix: Safe path returns None/empty/false; ABI preserves original
null_safety.hint: Prefer Option and early returns. Test both paths.
